from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case, including their role."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the party")
    role: str = Field(description="Role, e.g. 上诉人，被上诉人")

class MoneyDetail(BaseModel):
    """A specific monetary amount mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Numeric amount")
    description: str = Field(description="Description of the amount, e.g. 案件受理费，赔偿款")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who pays or bears the cost")

class CaseExtract(BaseModel):
    """Structured extraction from a single legal judgment document."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The case number (e.g., (2023) 冀 0630 民初 1641 号)")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case, e.g. 民事，行政，刑事")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties and their roles")
    verdict_summary: str | None = Field(description="Main outcome, e.g. 维持原判，驳回上诉，准许撤回")
    compensation_details: list[MoneyDetail] = Field(description="Compensation amounts if any")
    cost_details: list[MoneyDetail] = Field(description="Court fees and costs")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_extractions: list[CaseExtract]
